purpose: Resolve WT-009 RF-A1 HIGH (synthetic ETF proxy → real KOFIA NAV cross-validation) before Hybrid 70/15/15 admission

WT_008_KR_10y_proxy.method: ECOS yield series → bond duration approximation
known_limitations: Duration assumed constant 8 yr (actual KTB10Y ETF mod duration varies 6-9)
Carry computed from prev-month yield (not actual coupon flow)
No tracking error against actual KODEX 국고채10년 NAV

WT_009_TSMOM_synthetic_universe.method: Synthetic ETF returns built from underlying components (RAWDATA stocks for low-vol, FRED for gold/UST, ECOS for KR rates, etc.)
WT_009_TSMOM_synthetic_universe.rf_flag: RF-A1 HIGH — synthetic proxies not cross-validated against KOFIA actual ETF NAVs

step_1_data_acquisition.source: KOFIA (Korea Financial Investment Association) ETF NAV daily series
step_1_data_acquisition.period: 2015-01-02 to 2026-04-30 (joint 135m anchored on TSMOM live period)
step_1_data_acquisition.frequency: daily NAV (will be aggregated to month-end PIT)

monthly_correlation.fail_action: BLOCK admission. Investigate proxy method or replace with KOFIA NAV directly.

tracking_error_annualized.fail_action: Document deviation; if 1.5-3.0% → CONDITIONAL with uplift in cost; if > 3.0% BLOCK

cumulative_return_divergence.fail_action: Investigate dividend treatment; PIT alignment; share split adjustments

drawdown_alignment.fail_action: FLAG for risk-research review of tail risk implications

step_3_hybrid_re_simulation.purpose: Re-run Hybrid 70/15/15 with KOFIA NAV inputs (replacing synthetic proxy)
step_3_hybrid_re_simulation.comparison_baseline: Architect synthetic-proxy Hybrid (this WT) — delta tolerance ±0.05 SR / ±1pp MDD / ±0.5pp CAGR
step_3_hybrid_re_simulation.out_of_tolerance_action: BLOCK admission until proxy improvement OR adopt KOFIA NAV directly

step_4_bootstrap_ci.method: Stationary block bootstrap (Politis-Romano 1994) with block_size = sqrt(n) ≈ 12 months
step_4_bootstrap_ci.admission_criterion: lower 95% CI bound for Hybrid_SR_PerfA must NOT span baseline AR_on_M4 SR (1.7758) — i.e. Hybrid SR_lower_CI > 1.5 indicates stability

responsibility.verdict_review: Risk Manager (P4) + Architect (re-verify if KOFIA NAV materially changes Hybrid metrics)

estimated_runtime: ~2-4 hours (KOFIA daily pull + monthly aggregation + 9 ETF cross-validation + bootstrap 10000-iter)
blocking_status_for_admission: P2 must PASS before P7 governor admission. P3/P4/P5/P6 may run in parallel but must all consume KOFIA-validated inputs (not synthetic)

remediation_paths.scenario_A_all_pass: Hybrid synthetic proxy validated. Proceed to P3-P7. Document KOFIA NAV as reference.
remediation_paths.scenario_B_partial_fail: 1-2 tickers fail tolerance. Replace failing tickers with KOFIA NAV in Hybrid backtest. Document delta vs synthetic.
remediation_paths.scenario_C_systemic_fail: 3+ tickers fail OR Hybrid SR delta > 0.10. BLOCK admission. Re-architect TSMOM universe with KOFIA NAV first.
remediation_paths.scenario_D_KR_10y_only: If KR 10y (A148070) passes but TSMOM universe fails systemically: fallback to AR70_KR30 alone (drop TSMOM 15% → 70/30 KR10y bond replacement). Re-cycle as separate WT.

predecessor_concerns: WT-S20260504_009 RF-A1 HIGH (synthetic ETF universe not cross-validated)
